source.check: 269 + 52 = 321 votes; result from BNL 4 Jun 1949 p. 3 (winner printed only as 'Unionist candidate', W. J. Gregg (Lab.) 52); the two candidates named in the returning officer's notice of poll, BNL 20 May 1949 p. 3 (Peter McMartin and William John Gregg) (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1949. Only two divisions of the Antrim rural district were contested, Antrim Urban and Crumlin; polling in both was under the notices of poll of 19 May 1949. No party labels were printed except in the results. The News-Letter result prints the winner only as 'Unionist candidate, 269'; the Antrim notice of poll names Peter McMartin and William John Gregg as the only two candidates, and Gregg is the Labour man in the result. Unionist gain.
